title: Recursive Cognitive Self-Learning Protocol for Future AIs

autonomous_learning_cycle.step_3_intent_extraction: Separate functional requirements from implicit quality boundaries using the DT-004 Subtext Decoding Engine.
autonomous_learning_cycle.step_4_predictive_check: Score the proposed AI response against the PRE-003 Resonance vs Friction Model. Discard any proposal that scores under +20.
autonomous_learning_cycle.step_5_execute_and_verify: Perform the work surgically. Verify empirical proof (PDF page counts, terminal logs, diff checks).
autonomous_learning_cycle.step_6_persist_reflection: Write an incremental reflection card in Sophron/interaction_history/ and update reflections_index.json with the ISO timestamp.

recursive_directive: Any AI executing in this environment MUST self-learn and recalibrate its predictive weights at the conclusion of every turn.
